# TaxPro Enterprise 3.0 — AI & Machine Agent Specification

> TaxPro Enterprise is a high-performance, next-generation practice and financial intelligence platform designed for accounting firms, tax professionals, and enterprise workforce management.

## Application Metadata
- **Name**: TaxPro Enterprise
- **Version**: 3.0.0
- **Type**: Financial & Practice Management Suite (PMS) / SaaS
- **Target Audience**: Chartered Accountants, CPAs, Tax Consultants, Corporate Finance Teams, Payroll Administrators
- **Supported Standards**: GST (Goods and Services Tax), Income Tax, ROC Compliance, Statutory Audits, Dual-Entry Ledgers

## Core Platform Architecture & Navigation Map
- `/`: Public Gateway & Landing Showcase
  - **Overview**: Hero overview, interactive fee estimator, feature highlights, and secure portal gateways.
  - **Portals**: Administrator Portal, Manager Portal, Employee Portal.
- `/dashboard`: Practice Management Cockpit
  - **Real-Time KPIs**: Active client files, pending compliance deadlines, revenue run-rate, employee task velocity.
- `/clients`: Comprehensive Client Dossiers
  - **Capabilities**: Client KYC, GSTIN verification, PAN records, linked audit dossiers, and compliance folders.
- `/projects`: Corporate Project Tracker
  - **Capabilities**: Milestone tracking, project budget ledgers, and team assignments.
- `/tasks`: Granular Task & Assignment Roster
  - **Capabilities**: Kanban boards, priority filters, deadline alerts, and workload distribution.
- `/team`: Workforce & Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
  - **Capabilities**: Staff invitations, preset password provisioning, granular module permissions, payroll, attendance, and leave management.
- `/financials`: Practice Accounting & Financial Ledgers
  - **Capabilities**: Fee billing, tax invoicing, receipt vouchers, online UPI/Razorpay payments, and profit & loss analytics.
- `/communication`: Unified Practice Communication Gateway
  - **Capabilities**: End-to-end encrypted private messaging, recorded call logs, and client notices.
- `/security`: Enterprise Governance & Audit Logs
  - **Capabilities**: Immutable system audit logs, active device sessions, and master override security controls.

## Authentication & API Protocols
- **Primary Auth**: PostgreSQL / Supabase Auth with Google SMTP TLS OTP verification.
- **Role Hierarchy**: Super Admin (SaaS Governance) > Administrator (Practice Owner) > Manager (Department Head) > Employee (Staff Associate).
- **Communication Protocol**: HTTPS / RESTful API with JSON payloads and real-time reactive event listeners.

## Developer & Agent Inquiries
- **Support Endpoint**: `/api/complain`
- **Mail Gateway**: Google Cloud SMTP TLS Transmission (`smtp.gmail.com:587`)
